sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, paragraphs 1–3: three furnaces south of the palace, earliest workshop dated from the foundation to the first half of the seventh century, vessels, crucibles and workshop and residential samples.
Introduction and Sobre este lugar: foundation in 578 in honour of the king’s son, the commercial street rising to the palace and church, and the site near Zorita de los Canes.

processingNote.de: Die Fläche verortet das Areal bei Zorita de los Canes. Ihr Rand dient der Orientierung im Tal. Die ausgegrabenen Öfen liegen innerhalb des Fundplatzes.
processingNote.en: The outline indicates the site near Zorita de los Canes. Its edge offers orientation in the valley. The excavated furnaces lie within the archaeological site.
